name: MCat Source
author: marketCAT

sections.description:
MCat Source helps WooCommerce store owners understand where their customers are coming from. It adds a customizable “How did you hear about us?” field to the checkout or “Thank You” page and combines this data with technical tracking (UTMs, PixelYourSite).

Key Features:

  • Checkout Field: Adds a customizable question (e.g., “Where did you hear about us?”) to the checkout process.
  • Smart Analytics: Displays a summary of customer answers in the admin panel.
  • CSV Export: Exports a full report to CSV (Excel compatible) combining:
    • Customer Declaration (what they selected).
    • WooCommerce Order Attribution (UTMs, Organic, Direct).
    • PixelYourSite Data (Landing pages, detailed sources) – Smart Decoder included.
  • Admin Columns: Shows the source directly on the Orders list for quick inspection.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage.
  • Translation Ready: Fully prepared for localization.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/marketcat-ecommerce-analytics directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > MCat Source.
sections.faq:
Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with HPOS.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes, the plugin is fully internationalized. You can use software like Poedit or the Loco Translate plugin to translate it into your language.

Can I change the checkout question text without coding?

Yes! Just go to the plugin settings. You can enter the question and options in any language you want directly in the input fields.
